Same installed rootfs/packages, kernel/bootloader, FFT 0.3.0 archive, network configuration and current-V1 common service ordering. Only API/uWSGI/nginx protocol and LED runtime vary. Times use CLOCK_MONOTONIC from Linux boot, excluding bootloader/firmware; rootfs already expanded. These are not fresh generated-image boots or LAN readiness tests.
